hints.title: Minimax Game State
hints.text: Let score[i] be the maximum score difference the current player can achieve starting from index i.

hints.title: Three Possible Moves
hints.text: The current player can take 1, 2, or 3 stones. For each choice k in {1, 2, 3}, the score difference is sum(stoneValue[i..i+k-1]) - dp[i + k].

hints.title: Winner Evaluation
hints.text: Compute dp[0]. If dp[0] > 0 Alice wins, if dp[0] < 0 Bob wins, otherwise it is a Tie.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Game tree branching has 3^N states, leading to exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since dp[i] depends only on the next 3 states, 3 rolling variables achieve O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes minimax relative score difference and compares dp[0] against 0.
